duration: 'int | float | timedelta | np.timedelta64 | None' = None
timestamp: 'int | float | datetime | np.datetime64 | pa.TimestampScalar | None' = None
Set the current time of a timeline for this thread.
Used for all subsequent logging on the same thread
There is no requirement of monotonicity. You can move the time backwards if you like.
You are expected to set exactly ONE of the arguments `sequence`
You may NOT change the type of a timeline
column2: so if you use `duration` for a specific timeline

column1: you must only use `duration` for that timeline going forward.
